edges.reason: Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
msg.sender is stored as owner at deployment, defining the privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate transferOwnership.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership modifies privileged ownership state.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) authorizes the ownership claim.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
newOwner value flows into owner during acceptOwnership.
Parameter a is an operand of c = a + b inside safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of c = a + b inside safeAdd.
Parameter a is an operand of c = a - b inside safeSub.
Parameter b gates require(b <= a) in safeSub.
Parameter a is an operand of c = a * b inside safeMul.
Parameter b is an operand of c = a * b inside safeMul.
Parameter a is numerator of c = a / b inside safeDiv.
Parameter b is checked by require(b > 0) in safeDiv.

QToken constructor assigns the name state variable.

QToken constructor assigns the total supply state variable.

tokens amount is fed to safeSub and safeAdd on balances.

transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.

to parameter selects the credited balance entry.
tokens amount is passed to safeSub and safeAdd in transferFrom.

transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeSub to enforce sufficient balance and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the destination.
